title: Ordinary etale scalar pullback is the inverse scalar mate
statement:
The canonical ordinary etale scalar/pullback isomorphism is the inverse mate of the canonical exact restriction/pullback isomorphism under scalar adjunctions.

theorem scalarSheafPullbackIso_inverseMate
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((mateEquiv (ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction φ Y)
      (ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction φ X)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (upperStarRestrictScalarsIsoSheaf φ f).hom)).natTrans =
      (scalarSheafPullbackIso φ f).inv

proof.text: Transpose the restriction/pullback square under the geometric adjunctions. Its definition by restriction/coextension and the coextension triangle identity identify its geometric mate with the sectionwise restriction/direct-image identity. The iterated-mate/conjugation identity and injectivity of conjugation under the two composite adjunctions then identify its inverse scalar mate with the inverse ordinary scalar/pullback isomorphism. All equalities are functorial; no flatness or boundedness is used.
